name: Planet Ozi
summary: ISP (Planet Ozi Pty Ltd, ACN 108 139 037) that absorbed CairnsNet customer base (2017) and ran Silogen/Starwon brand; ADSL/NBN/dialup provider; ABN cancelled 2020; customers/services absorbed by Adelaide's EscapeNet (esc.net.au).

events.details: Planet Ozi Pty Ltd incorporated; business name TSN Internet.com.au from Mar 2004.
Customers/services absorbed by EscapeNet (Adelaide); site last live ~Mar 2021.
